name: A Blocked Active Root Transfers to Carrier Depth Two
statement: In a two-connected terminal interval of order at most eleven, let $d$ be an active root for which $L\cup\{d\}$ is ample. The unique minimal active carrier $E_P$ containing $d$ contains a concept $o\ne d$ that belongs to at least two minimal active carriers.
proof: The one-concept colon criterion identifies $P=N_L(d)$ as the unique minimal support represented by $d$. A passive blocker meets $E_P$ without containing $d$. Choose the common owner $o$ of all passive boundary types incident with $E_P$; then $o\ne d$. If $o$ belonged to only $E_P$, the local one-concept criterion would make $L\cup\{o\}$ ample with unique carrier $E_P$. Applying the passive-root cover to $o$ would produce an incident passive boundary type omitting $o$, contradicting its choice as common owner. Hence $o$ has carrier depth at least two.
